hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); blocked=false; case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*|*"git push"*) blocked=true;; esac; case "$cmd" in *"--dry-run"*) blocked=false;; esac; if $blocked; then branch=$(git -C /Users/scray/dev/projects/limen rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" = "main" ]; then jq -nc --arg msg "Refusing to git commit/push on main — create a feature branch first: git checkout -b <name>" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$msg}}'; fi; fi
